propositions: Grounding finders (G1G2/E4/E6) flag symbols as missing/unverifiable when a prerequisite ticket will create them, even though the plan depends_on that ticket, because only the origin/main snapshot is considered.

A machine-parseable citation [rebar:<ticket-id>] must be honored via a two-layer protocol: Layer-1 deterministic advisory verification of upstream dependency edges (both directions: depends_on or blocks), and Layer-2 LLM coverage judgment via show_ticket.

Layer-1 det_citation.py must parse [rebar:<id>] citations, verify edges in both directions (P.depends_on(C) or C.blocks(P)), handle reverse-lookup failures gracefully (fail-closed), and emit only advisory findings without blocking.

Layer-2 grounding finders credit a citation only if Layer-1 verifies the edge AND the LLM affirmatively confirms the cited ticket's plan/file_impact establishes the specific functionality claimed missing.
Edge-unbacked citations, failed reverse lookups, or coverage-absent citations must not credit the symbol—the normal missing-symbol block applies (fail-closed).
The det_citation logic must reside in a separate module to respect the det_floor LOC policy, and resolve_deps must be injected to enable unit testing without hard _reads imports.
